project_type: Astro static blog with MDX content collections, AdSense, analytics, and RSS
test_framework: Vitest + fast-check for property tests, Playwright for built-output checks
verification_instructions: 1. pnpm install --frozen-lockfile, 2. pnpm lint, 3. pnpm astro check, 4. pnpm build, 5. pnpm test (unit+property), 6. pnpm test:output (built-output SEO/feed/ad/a11y/perf)
environment_constraints: Full internet access available. Node v22.23.1, pnpm 10.28.1 pre-installed.
contribution_requirements: Each starter is standalone - no imports from root or other starters. Must have project-local manifest/lockfile. starter.json with exact catalog identity. All validation commands must be non-interactive one-shot.
key_patterns: Existing starters use starter.json for identity projection. Root catalog at catalog/starters.json. Validation profile AST = pnpm; Vitest + fast-check + Playwright; ESLint, astro check, astro build. Content/AdSense blueprint: src/content for typed records, src/pages for static routes, src/seo for metadata/sitemap/RSS, src/components/Ad.* for consent-aware ad component, src/analytics for consent-consuming initializer, tests/ for all checks, scripts/validate-site.* for built-output validation.
directory_structure: astro-adsense-blog/ will be created at repository root. Key subdirs: src/content/ (MDX collections), src/pages/ (static routes), src/seo/ (metadata/canonical/robots/sitemap/RSS), src/components/ (Ad component, layout), src/analytics/ (consent-consuming initializer), tests/ (all test suites), scripts/ (validate-site output checks)
